the hyperfine structure of muonic hydrogen is dominated by the non-perturbatively computed proton charge density, and that this non-perturbativity is due to a strong coupling between the proton and the muon.

the non-perturbatively calculated hyperfine splittings of muonic hydrogen agree with the experimental results within their experimental uncertainties.
